An '''entrance chime''' was a kind of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] technology that announces an individual's presence outside a room.<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Filba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] room on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] had an entrance chime installed.<ref name="MedStar I" />
